about.title: A digital commons for the African world
about.intro: Wakanze is a long-term project to connect African peoples and the diaspora across history, geography, culture, knowledge and generations.
about.body1: The history of the African diaspora is not only a story of displacement. It is also a story of creation: new cultures, new languages, new communities on every continent.
about.body2: Wakanze starts with something simple: a place to read those stories, meet the people telling them and find others nearby who care about the same things.
about.quote: From a diaspora of individuals to a network of communities.
about.body3: Everything else, from local circles to education and shared projects, grows from the people who choose to take part. That is why the first thing we ask is how you would like to be involved.
